## User Need / Problem Statement
A clear description of the problem this feature solves.
*Example: School accountants spend 2 hours manually reconciling bKash payments each morning...*

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it should work.

## User Personas Impacted
- [ ] School Owner / Principal
- [ ] School Administrator
- [ ] Teacher
- [ ] Parent / Guardian
- [ ] Student

## Localization & Bangladesh Specifics
- **Currency Impact:** Does this touch `৳` (BDT) calculations or receipts?
- **Language:** English + বাংলা string requirements.
- **Regulatory/Academic:** Does this follow the Bangladesh Board / Ministry of Education guidelines?

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.
